objective: Compare minimum cost to reach the same independently measured approximation error, while requiring conserved charge and a qualified certificate where applicable.

special_cases: auto-mps swaps and splits two-qubit gates
lazy/permutation MPS ordering must be included as separate baselines
CircuitMPSLazy supports delayed compression schedules; record compress_every and compression method separately.
CircuitPermMPS lazily tracks qubit/site ordering; record the logical-to-physical permutation and include the ordering-management cost.
quimb.fidelity_and_error_semantics: CircuitMPS fidelity_estimate and error_estimate are norm-based estimates tied to truncation. They are internal controls, not the independent oracle; use dense-state L2 and infidelity for N<=12.

itensor.limitation: ITensor QN support is Abelian, which matches U(1). Its current GPU documentation cautions that QN block-sparse GPU operations are less mature than dense GPU operations and may not work or may be slower; report CPU and GPU comparisons separately.

qiskit_aer.fairness: Threshold is based on discarded squared Schmidt coefficients; report independent state L2 and infidelity rather than treating the threshold itself as L2.
qiskit_aer.truncation_semantics: matrix_product_state_truncation_threshold discards the smallest Schmidt coefficients whose summed squares fall below the configured threshold. mps_log_data reports bond dimensions and discarded values. This is not a global state-L2 certificate.

cutensornet.limitation: Do not compare distributed SVD as distributed MPS gate execution; documented distributed decomposition support and gate-split support are distinct.
special_cases: ProjectionMPS insertion exposes absolute/relative/discarded-weight cutoffs, SVD normalization and per-insertion SVD_MAX_EXTENT.
Keep normalization-preserving and no-renormalization runs in separate result tables.
Distributed tensor SVD in decomposition APIs is not the same as distributed gateSplit; gateSplit currently does not support distributed tensors.

tdvp.fairness: Compare at identical physical time and observables; report projection, Krylov, truncation and time-discretization errors separately.

workloads.hamiltonian: H[1,2]=H[2,1]=J; all other entries zero in basis |00>,|01>,|10>,|11>.

workloads.circuit: canonicalize at bonds 0 and 1; phase gate on first pair; exact split and budgeted split controls

workloads.hamiltonian: nearest-neighbour XXZ with exchange Jxy=1, anisotropy Delta=0.7, longitudinal field h=0.13
same nearest-neighbour XXZ generator as U1-XXZ-8
goals: certificate coverage at the dense-oracle boundary

workloads.circuit: seeded nearest-neighbour brick-wall layers with each gate in U(1) block form 1 direct_sum U(2) direct_sum 1
workloads.oracle: dense statevector for selected seeds and checkpoints

goals: cost to reach target observable error

workloads.initial_state: fixed-charge random state and fixed-charge product state controls
workloads.oracle: dense small-N analogue and cross-simulator convergence at N=32

qualification_targets.global_bound_coverage: actual dense-reference L2 error must never exceed the qualified recorded bound within declared numerical slack
qualification_targets.global_bound_tightness: measure bound/actual ratio; set a target only after pilot data

research_targets_not_claims.matched_cpu_runtime: within 2x Quimb median at equal independently measured error for nearest-neighbour N<=32; not yet measured
research_targets_not_claims.memory: quantify current dense zero-storage overhead first; target packed charge-block payload savings only after implementation
research_targets_not_claims.adaptive_compression: at equal local L2 target, use the minimum global Schmidt rank and no more rank than a fixed relative-cutoff baseline
research_targets_not_claims.large_n: N=16,24,32 first; N=48,64 after stable accuracy and memory curves; N=128 only after N=64 qualification

explicit_nonclaims: No current matched SOTA performance win.
No current packed block-sparse production storage.
No Trotter/time-discretization certificate from the canonical/gate/model/compression ledger.
No dense-reference accuracy claim for N>12.
